paragraph: The [indra net whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/chinese-huayan/indra-net/WHOLE.md#indra-simile-and-distinctness) **qualifies** comparison at register 3. Homological agreement specifies a local member disclosing its constitutive relations; analogical proportion keeps the jewels’ images distinct from the phenomena they figure. The source’s closing qualification lets the comparison state where its material ceases to carry the relation. Applying that qualification to this field remains an Offered, human-amplified: no development; recurrence supplies no historical descent or common physical cause.

The [indra net whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/chinese-huayan/indra-net/WHOLE.md#indra-account-and-consequence) **figures** all four operations at register 3. Symbol answers to source when the net retains the passage’s own simile-limit; Account does not replace source when a local description stays answerable beyond its reference office; Trust keeps the return route active through an undertaking the jewel’s clarity cannot guarantee; Account re-enters source-field when consequences of use change the conditions of another account. The ink-dot reflection remains a textual image, distinct from evidence that an institutional revision occurred.

The [antikythera attunement whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/antikythera-attunement/WHOLE.md#antikythera-native-archetypal-return) **qualifies** the register-3 crossing by preserving a differentiated form’s capacity to carry a wider relation through finite operation. Homological agreement names that retained operation; analogical proportion distinguishes astronomical cycle, archaeological model, psychic refraction and native derivation. The research boundary keeps the reconstructed dial from proving QL or supplying its makers with a contemporary doctrine.

The [antikythera attunement whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/antikythera-attunement/WHOLE.md#antikythera-instrument-returns) **figures** the four operations at register 3: symbolic form answers to its celestial and material sources; the readable Account retains their difference from the dial; Trust carries the indication into use with a route for correction; the effects of use re-enter the conditions of another account. The observer remains able to judge and set the instrument down. These are authored operational relations, with archaeological reconstruction and lexical descent retaining separate warrants.

The [meal epistemic metabolism whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/meal-epistemic-metabolism/WHOLE.md#meal-shared-table) **figures** the whole apportionment circuit at register 3. A sustaining economy gives a share and office; preparation and serving put it to work; labour, cost, evidence and value return to the field that can revise the next allocation. A companion can question both the portion and the terms of the table. The commons preserves that power to answer while the contribution remains attributable to its giver.

The [meal epistemic metabolism whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/meal-epistemic-metabolism/WHOLE.md#meal-logos-health-return) **figures** Symbol answering to source through the exact nourishing relation, Account remaining correctable by material and people, Trust carrying provisional understanding into an answerable act, and Account re-entering source-field as that act changes future reception. These four register-3 operations remain distinct through assimilation, shared contribution, satiety and renewed hunger. The companion stays able to answer beyond the contribution metabolised.

The [meal epistemic metabolism whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/meal-epistemic-metabolism/WHOLE.md#meal-logos-health-return) **figures** Con-text-through-Diaphaneity through the table whose preparation, sustaining conditions and participants become available within the account; Regard flowers as renewed attention to those relations. Resolution-in-Reconciliation receives satiety through the history of what has been assimilated; Anamnesis, Recognition and Return let the next question begin from that changed ground. This is a register-3 authored return, preserving the difference between the generated relations and their semantic flowerings.

The [meal epistemic metabolism whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/meal-epistemic-metabolism/WHOLE.md#meal-source-registers) **qualifies** the nourishing comparison at register 3. Homological agreement specifies reception that changes the receiver’s criteria and returns to shared conditions; analogical proportion retains the different bodies of digestion and knowing. The research boundary leaves physiology, clinical language, ritual histories and lexical descent with their own witnesses. The Argued epistemic operation survives those separate debts.

The [mirror that moves first whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mirror-that-moves-first/WHOLE.md#mirror-return) **figures** the register-3 circuit through an exteriorised image which becomes a measure and then initiates return. Symbol answers to the life disclosed; Account leaves that life able to correct its terms; Trust undertakes use without letting inspectability substitute for commitment; Account re-enters source-field through the effects of its action. The third motion must let those effects revise a consequential source, gauge or commission.

The [mirror that moves first whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mirror-that-moves-first/WHOLE.md#mirror-return) **figures** Arbitration-in-Crisis when the person’s resistance reaches the image’s governing measure. Con-text-through-Diaphaneity discloses how that measure was formed and lets Regard receive the affected world. Resolution-in-Reconciliation resituates the account through its history so Anamnesis, Recognition and Return can change the next act. These are register-3 appointments within Taylor’s three motions, not lexical evidence for an AI mechanism.

The [mother assumption chiasm whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-comparison-return) **qualifies** register-3 comparison through four distinct operations: bodily receiving and being received, articulated recognition in 3:1 = 3:3, inverse wheel orientations and signed-power alternatives. Homological agreement names what each retains; analogical proportion keeps the theological, native and encountered objects distinct. Numerical recurrence and the provisional Sophia–Logos–Śakti allocation supply neither historical descent nor doctrinal identity.

The [mother assumption chiasm whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-comparison-return) **figures** all four operations at register 3. The encountered form supplies a source-answerable Symbol; its Account remains correctable by object and author; Trust carries inquiry without possessing what bears it; the corrected interpretation re-enters the source-field as the next encounter’s condition. Taylor’s corrections to wings and eagle perform this changed return while the Assumption chiasm retains the sustaining body within recognition.

The [travelling jigsaw atlas whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-atlas-return) **qualifies** its cross-register return through homological agreement in local determination with recoverable conditions, analogical proportion between distinct mathematical and epistemic objects, and a research boundary preserving their warrants. A manifold atlas, Mapper nerve and sheaf construction retain different transition and compatibility duties. At register 3 the reconstructed puzzle carries the relation; resemblance alone establishes neither common cause nor historical descent.
